sentences.l2: 我们的身体里住着很多小小的生命，我们叫它们“微生物组”。
sentences.l1: Many tiny lives live in our bodies, and we call them "microbiome".

sentences.l2: 这些小生命很多住在我们的肠道里，它们对我们的“免疫”系统很重要。
sentences.l1: Many of these little lives live in our intestines, and they are very important to our "immune" system.

sentences.l2: 免疫系统就像身体的军队，保护我们不生病。
sentences.l1: The immune system is like the body's army, protecting us from getting sick.

sentences.l2: 有时候，身体的军队会出错，攻击自己的身体，这叫做“自身免疫”。
sentences.l1: Sometimes, the body's army makes mistakes and attacks its own body, which is called "autoimmunity".

sentences.l2: 肠道微生物组可以帮助训练免疫系统，让它不会出错。
sentences.l1: The gut microbiome can help train the immune system so that it does not make mistakes.

sentences.l2: 所以，保持“肠道健康”很重要，这能帮助我们减少“自身免疫”疾病的可能。
sentences.l1: So, keeping "gut health" is very important, and it can help us reduce the possibility of "autoimmune" diseases.

sentences.l2: 如果肠道里的微生物组不平衡，免疫系统就容易出错。
sentences.l1: If the microbiome in the intestines is unbalanced, the immune system easily makes mistakes.
